event:
I withdrew the finding: other spec text in the repository answers both of its questions.

- **Field width:** `hw/ip/aon_timer/doc/registers.md:57` lists the prescaler field at bits 12:1, so it is 12 bits wide with a reset value of 0.
- **Division rule:** `hw/ip/aon_timer/README.md:32` says "The number of cycles per tick is one more than the 12-bit `WKUP_CTRL.prescaler` field." So the wakeup count increments once every prescaler+1 AON clock cycles.

I also added `hw/ip/aon_timer/README.md` as a new source, since the finding did not cite it. I did not look at the RTL or the tests.
